title: Account cache leaks across tenants

-def cache_key_account(account_id: str) -> str:

+def cache_key_account(tenant_id: str, account_id: str) -> str:
+    return f"acct:{tenant_id}:{account_id}"
 
 
 def cache_key_invoice(invoice_id: str) -> str:

@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
 def get_account(account_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
     ctx = require_tenant()

+    key = cache.cache_key_account(ctx.tenant_id, account_id)
     hit = cache.get(key)

         return hit

title: Money.split loses cents

answer.patch:
--- a/pkg/money.py
+++ b/pkg/money.py
@@ -25,6 +25,8 @@
         if parts <= 0:
             raise ValueError("parts must be positive")
-        share = self.cents / parts
-        base = int(share)
-        return [Money(base, self.currency) for _ in range(parts)]
+        base, remainder = divmod(self.cents, parts)
+        return [
+            Money(base + (1 if i < remainder else 0), self.currency)
+            for i in range(parts)
+        ]
